explanation: The value is 0 everywhere except at GO, where it is about 9-10 when the previous trial was an a2 choice that went to S1 by a rare transition and was rewarded, and the agent picks a2 again; this gets lower earlier in the episode (about 6 near trial 40, 9-10 from trial 55 to 70).
